response.original_title: Adding-Guest-How do I add passengers to my MSC Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, you must contact MSC Cruises customer service +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or your travel agent directly, as cabin capacity limits and lifeboat allocations require manual modification by the cruise line.
